title: Artifact
description: One revision of a named output of a work item: typed, stored and traced (ADR 0049).

name.description: The output's name, as the transition declares it.

type.description: The declared type, or the type of the value or file.

media_type.description: The IANA media type the content is served with.

version.description: 1 for the first revision; a new content makes the next one.

digest.description: sha256 of the bytes served on download, checked again on every read.

size.description: Size of the content in bytes.

produced_by.description: The run that produced this revision, and the agent behind it.

agent.description: The registry agent (ADR 0033); null for a playbook.

storage_url.description: Where the bytes are in the object store; null for an inline artifact.
